candidate.contract_code:
pub assume_specification<T: Ord>[ <[T]>::sort_unstable ](
    slice: &mut [T],
)
    requires
        obeys_cmp::<T>(),
    ensures
        final(slice)@.to_multiset() =~= old(slice)@.to_multiset(),
        sorted_by(
            final(slice)@,
            |x: T, y: T| x.cmp_spec(&y) != Ordering::Greater,
        ),
;
ensures: sorted_by(final(slice)@, |x: T, y: T| x.cmp_spec(&y) != Ordering::Greater)
candidate.rationale: The source sorts in place using T::lt. Existing vstd ordering, sequence, and multiset vocabulary expresses ascending order and element preservation while leaving equal-element order unconstrained.
risks: The ordering guarantee requires obeys_cmp::<T>() to connect runtime Ord behavior to cmp_spec.
The contract describes normal return; comparator panics are not modeled.
